sharedSchema22.description: Lifecycle condition for looping animations (requires the top-level loop: true field). The animation plays while the condition is true and stops automatically when it becomes false. Note: to_state/from_state are fire-and-forget gates — they control when the animation starts but will not stop it. Use while to auto-stop a looping animation. The 4 numeric bound keys (above/at_least/below/at_most) AND-combine when more than one is present, so a range can be expressed by combining two of them — e.g. { at_least: 20, at_most: 80 } for an inclusive range, or { above: 20, below: 80 } for an exclusive one.

not_state.description: Play while entity value does NOT equal this string

above.description: Play while numeric entity value is strictly above this threshold

at_least.description: Play while numeric entity value is greater than or equal to this threshold

below.description: Play while numeric entity value is strictly below this threshold

at_most.description: Play while numeric entity value is less than or equal to this threshold

font_weight.description: Font weight — CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

template.description: Template evaluation is enabled by default for this field’s content (e.g. {entity.state}, {{ states(...) }}, [[[ ... ]]]). Set to false to render {...} / [[[...]]] text literally without evaluating it.

oneOf.description: true = stretch text to fill 100% of the available width
Fraction of available width to stretch text to (0–1)

stretch.description: Stretch text to fill a fraction of the available width using SVG textLength / lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs". true = 100%, 0.8 = 80%.

font_size_percent.description: Font size as a percentage of the text area height (component mode). Overrides font_size when set.

cap_height_ratio.description: Ratio of the font cap-height to the em-square. Used to correct font_size_percent so visible glyph height matches the requested percentage. Defaults to the theme token value (0.86 for Antonio). Override when using a different font.

zone.description: Named zone key to route this text field to. For component cards this matches a key in the component's zones map. For slider/elbow cards this matches a named layout zone (e.g. left, track, vertical_bar). Defaults to the first zone if not set.

display_format.description: How to format entity state or attribute values in this text field. "friendly" (default) uses HA's translated display string matching native cards. "raw" returns the unmodified state/attribute value. "parts" joins value and unit from HA's ToParts API. "unit" returns only the unit portion.

background_padding.description: Horizontal padding between text glyphs and the background rect edges (px).

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

animations.description: Visual animations triggered by user interactions or entity state changes

shape_texture.description: Canvas texture/animation rendered inside the elbow shape boundary

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier. Supports state-based object.

config.description: Preset-specific configuration. Supports entity-reactive values: map_range descriptor or template strings.

filters.description: Visual filters applied to entire elbow (CSS and SVG filter primitives)

symbiont.description: Embed another HA card inside the elbow content area with optional style imprinting

overflow.description: CSS overflow for both axes of the symbiont container. Overridden per-axis by overflow_x / overflow_y. Default: hidden.

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x for the symbiont container (horizontal axis). Overrides overflow shorthand.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y for the symbiont container (vertical axis). Overrides overflow shorthand.

position.description: Padding within the elbow content area (px)

imprint.description: Style imprinting — injects resolved styles into the embedded card shadow root

background.description: Background colour to inject into embedded card. Null = do not imprint.

color.description: Text colour to inject into embedded card. Null = do not imprint.

font_size.description: Font size to inject (e.g. "14px"). Null = do not imprint.

font_family.description: Font family string to inject. Null = do not imprint.

match_host.description: Derive border radius from elbow inner arc geometry

oneOf.description: Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

top_left.description: Top-left border radius — number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

oneOf.description: Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

top_right.description: Top-right border radius — number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

oneOf.description: Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

bottom_left.description: Bottom-left border radius — number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

oneOf.description: Use 'match' to mirror the elbow's inner arc radius

bottom_right.description: Bottom-right border radius — number (px) or 'match' to mirror elbow inner arc

custom_style.description: Raw CSS injected into child card shadowRoot after imprint styles. Does not require card-mod.

card.description: Any valid HA card configuration (type + properties). card_mod blocks are passed through as-is.

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

source.description: Single entity ID (auto-creates DataSource with defaults)

attribute.description: Entity attribute to track (optional - works with source)

anyOf.title: Simple String Array
anyOf.description: Array of entity IDs or DataSource names (simple format)

anyOf.title: Mixed Array (Strings and Objects)
anyOf.description: Array with mix of simple strings and advanced source objects

series_names.description: Custom legend names for series (matches sources order)

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

max_points.description: Maximum data points to display (0 = unlimited)

style.description: Nested style configuration for chart appearance

colors.description: Complete colour configuration for all chart elements

background.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

foreground.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

grid.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

x.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

border.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

ticks.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

default.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

fill.description: Fill configuration for area and bar charts

decimals.description: Round displayed values to N decimal places (axis labels, tooltips, and data labels)

color.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, theme token, or CSS variable)

chart_options.description: Raw ApexCharts options (highest precedence - overrides all other settings)

oneOf.title: Simple Row
oneOf.description: Array of cell values (auto-detects static text, entity IDs, or templates)

oneOf.title: Styled Row
oneOf.description: Row with values and optional style overrides

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

lcards-alert-overlay.title: LCARdS Alert Overlay
lcards-alert-overlay.description: Full-screen alert overlay card that reacts to the lcards_alert_mode input_select

dismiss_mode.description: dismiss = hide overlay only; reset = hide + set alert_mode back to green_alert; auto-dismiss = automatically hide after auto_dismiss_seconds; auto-reset = automatically hide and reset alert_mode after auto_dismiss_seconds

auto_dismiss_seconds.description: Seconds before the overlay auto-dismisses. Required when dismiss_mode is auto-dismiss or auto-reset. Can be overridden per condition under conditions.<key>.auto_dismiss_seconds.

backdrop.description: [DEPRECATED] Migrated at runtime to layers.backdrop + layers.color. Still accepted for backward compatibility.

oneOf.description: null — explicitly disables all screen effect layers (useful as a per-condition override).
Screen effect layers applied independently behind the overlay. Absent slot = disabled; null slot = explicitly cleared.
Explicitly disable this layer for a condition override
CSS backdrop-filter layer. Preset: blur | grayscale | saturate | contrast | hue-rotate
Explicitly disable this layer for a condition override
Colour overlay layer. Preset: color-tint | vignette
Explicitly disable this layer for a condition override
Canvas animation layer. Preset: static | pixelate | glitch | scanlines

conditions.description: Per-condition overrides. Keys match alert mode values (red_alert, yellow_alert, etc.)

content.description: HA card config to render inside the overlay for this condition

alert_button.description: Patch merged on top of the default lcards-button alert card for this condition. Only specify fields to override — type, component, and preset are inherited from the built-in default. Supports all lcards-button text and alert config keys. Ignored when `content` is also specified (content takes full precedence).

text.description: Text field overrides — e.g. text.sub_text.content or text.alert_text.content

alert.description: Alert component config overrides — e.g. alert.color.shape, alert.color.bars

backdrop.description: [DEPRECATED] Migrated at runtime to layers. Still accepted for backward compatibility.

layers.description: Per-condition screen effect layer overrides. Unset slots inherit from the global layers config. null = explicitly disable that slot.

auto_dismiss_seconds.description: Override auto-dismiss duration for this specific condition. Only relevant when the global dismiss_mode is auto-dismiss or auto-reset.

lcards-select-menu.title: LCARdS Select Menu Card Configuration
lcards-select-menu.description: Renders an input_select entity as a grid of LCARS-styled option buttons. Each button calls input_select.select_option when tapped. The selected option is styled as "active", all others as "inactive".

entity.description: input_select (or select) entity whose options become buttons

id.description: Unique card identifier for rule targeting, animations, and debugging (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

preset.description: Button style preset applied to all option buttons (e.g. lozenge, filled, outline)

grid.description: Grid layout config for option buttons. Supports CSS Grid shorthand or full properties.

columns.description: Number of columns (shorthand → repeat(N, 1fr)) or full CSS grid-template-columns value

rows.description: Number of rows or CSS grid-template-rows value

gap.description: CSS gap shorthand (applies to both row and column gap)

grid-auto-rows.description: CSS grid-auto-rows for implicit row height

height.description: "fit": sizes the card host to the exact height of all buttons (useful for outer grid track sizing). "100%": proportionally fills a bounded parent row, resizing buttons to fit without overflow. For a fixed card height with scrolling, use the top-level height + overflow_y config instead.

oneOf.description: Object form: per-option overrides keyed by option value. Entity order is preserved.
Array form: explicit ordered list (also filters which options are shown). Each item must have a "value" key.

options.description: Per-option configuration. Object: override by name (entity order preserved). Array: explicit order + filter.

style.description: Style applied to all option buttons. Uses the same stateColor schema as lcards-button. active = selected, inactive = unselected.

background.description: Option button background color (state-based or static)

radius.description: Border radius (px or CSS string). Object form for per-corner control.

opacity.description: Base opacity for unselected options (0-1). Defaults to 0.88 if not specified.

tap_action.description: Override the default select_option tap action for ALL option buttons (per-option tap_action takes priority).
